'''Free Fire World Series - Global Finals 2024''' is the final event of the 2024 competitive season, organized by [[Garena]].

==About==
* {{Team|RZX Esports}} did not participate due to VISA issues and the team is automatically awarded 18th place. The championship continued with 17 teams.<ref name="rzx visa issue">{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DCCU3HuTIaD/ |title=A Fighter's Journey Interrupted. |publisher='''Garena Free Fire Esports''' |date=2024-11-06}}</ref>
* {{TeamIcon|btr dlt}}&nbsp;{{Player|BTR.Kojaa|link=Kojaaaa}} violated the league's rules and was banned from playing for 1 day and fined $500 {{Abbr/USD}}.<ref name="kojaa violate rule">{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/legendgarenafreefirevn/posts/pfbid02oHxUmg1BFA5nksaHbEnfFyDxqFY9LTcTCmFr5SXRsLuXVgFNgyXvxviBZGFXwrJgl |title=THÔNG BÁO XỬ PHẠT - TUYỂN THỦ BTR.KOJAA |trans_title=NOTICE OF SANCTION - PLAYER BTR.KOJAA |language={{FlagNoLink|vn}} ''Vietnamese'' |publisher='''Huyền Thoại Sinh Tồn - Free Fire''' |date=2024-11-16}}</ref>
* {{TeamIcon|hua}}&nbsp;{{Player|HUA.Popi|link=Popi}} violated the league's rules and was banned from playing for 1 day and fined $500 {{Abbr/USD}}.<ref name="popi violate rule">{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/legendgarenafreefirevn/posts/pfbid0oNyurDcyPCum8CUDY4E9qn8NAq25aQ5LujdVqFbL8RdzFPLjC6WLRut1GsVtrW2Ml |title=THÔNG BÁO XỬ PHẠT - TUYỂN THỦ HUA.POPI |trans_title=NOTICE OF SANCTION - PLAYER HUA.POPI |language={{FlagNoLink|vn}} ''Vietnamese'' |publisher='''Huyền Thoại Sinh Tồn - Free Fire''' |date=2024-11-22}}</ref>

===Format===
* '''Knockout Stage:''''' November 8th - 17th, 2024 at the Rio Centro Convention, {{FlagNoLink|br}} Rio de Janeiro
** 18 teams, divided into 3 groups of 6 teams.
** 2 weeks:
*** Each week consist of 3 matchdays.
*** Each matchday consist of 6 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 12 teams}} advance to ''Point Rush'' and ''Grand Finals''.
<div style="margin-top:12px"></div>
* '''Point Rush:''''' November 22nd - 23rd, 2024 at the Carioca Arena 1, {{FlagNoLink|br}} Rio de Janeiro
** 12 teams.
** 12 matches (6 each day).
** Teams receive Headstart Points after each day based on their daily standings.
<div style="margin-top:12px"></div>
* '''Grand Finals:''''' November 24th, 2024 at the Carioca Arena 1, {{FlagNoLink|br}} Rio de Janeiro
** 12 teams.
** 6 matches.

==Format==
* '''FFWS 2024 - Knockout Stage:''''' November 8th - 17th, 2024
** 18 teams, divided into 3 groups of 6 teams.
** 2 weeks:
*** Each week consist of 3 matchdays.
*** Each matchday consist of 6 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|'''Top 12 teams'''}} qualify for '''Points Rush''' and '''Grand Finals'''.
